title: pvExtractGhostCells
body:
## pvExtractGhostCells

Extracts only the ghost cells of the input (the overlap layers that parallel or partitioned data carry to neighbouring pieces) so they can be inspected, and records the original ghost flags in an array named ArrayName. Use it to debug decompositions or ghost-cell generation; data without ghost cells gives an empty output.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- ArrayName must differ from vtkGhostType, or the extracted cells are treated as ghosts again and hidden.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ExtractGhostCells`. Identity: `filters/ExtractGhostCells`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet); composite data (multiblock or partitioned collections) (vtkCompositeDataSet); hyper-tree grids (adaptive AMR-like trees) (vtkHyperTreeGrid). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet","vtkCompositeDataSet","vtkHyperTreeGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ArrayName` | Name of the ghost cell array in the output. It must be different to `vtkGhostType` in order for the cells to be displayed. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |

```json
  "mode": "serial",
```


### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvExtractGhostCells",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
